harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: UNGUARDED shared-memory loads armed on ONE write barrier one after another WITHOUT a wait and read behind ONE wait (kind ord, the scale set of probe.py 29): S = `LDS` into a block-scale register of two guarded tensor instructions (`@P0 QMMA.SF`, 16 cycles behind it `@P2 QMMA.SF`), D = `LDS.64` whose pair two `MOV` instructions read; the one wait stands on the first reader instruction - a tensor instruction also where its guard is false, or the first `MOV` where the `MOV` readers stand first; every second load through another base register; a load brings the UE8M0 code of the unit scale (S) or a pair of the thread's constants (D), and until it lands its register holds the code of x 2 / the iteration's input; each request with its positive control (the same text with that one wait bit moved to the first instruction behind the reader instructions); six grids; the mixed sets S,S,D,D,S,S,D (a whole flight of seven loads of a schedule of a vendor's MoE kernel whose loop loads do not wait on the barrier they arm), S,D,D,S,S,D and D,D,S,S,D (its views by single readers; in the last the `MOV` readers stand first); the tensor readers' predicates true + false, false + true and two bits of the iteration counter; the loads 1 and 4 cycles apart; the first reader 2 cycles behind the last arming and at 20 (the second tensor reader then at 36)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: 53c8224 tools/stallfloor/probe.py 27 and 28: a wait under another predicate (kind gp), the readers of a CS2UR result, a

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
